series.definition: U.S. Energy Information Administration international data. Native geoset INTL.2-2-BKWH.A; source series and observations remain identified per row. The native physical unit is retained; no conversion to WDI, Mtoe, Energy Institute total energy supply or other source editions is performed.
limitations: Frozen publisher source bytes acquired 1 November 2026; this is not a live feed or a claim that all values are direct measurements.
Source units, quantities, source year labels and unavailable values are retained. No local interpolation, carry-forward, averaging, zero filling or numerical unit conversion is performed.

Countries and territories follow the publisher labels and country definitions. Historical borders or reporting populations may change even when a country name does not. Modern map geometry does not establish equivalent historical territory.
Production, consumption, trade, installed capacity and energy-accounting measures are separate. Native energy-content and physical units must not be added as independent quantities.
Selected annual source measures are separate from the retained earlier historical reconstruction and from WDI measures. No automatic stitching fills the 1979/1980 source boundary.
API/bulk metadata do not provide a separate estimate flag for every observation. A numerical source value is not automatically a direct physical measurement.
Source groups and historical or unresolved geographies remain in the source-entities collection rather than being assigned to modern countries.
